Assistant (0.3s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms Lin?

User (1.5s): Yes, this is Grace Lin.

Assistant (2.1s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.5s): Twenty-third of February nineteen eighty-nine.

Assistant (5.6s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (6.8s): Nine nine zero four.

Assistant (9.8s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your credit card ending 7740 has a past-due amount of 365.00, which is 8 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (13.2s): I cannot pay that today. I can pay the full amount this Friday.

Assistant (15.8s): To confirm: you will pay 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (17.1s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (43.8s): Thank you. Your promise of 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
